mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, due_date, priority, repeat_type, reminder, tag, created_at FROM daily_tasks ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, title, description, due_date, priority, repeat_type, reminder, tag, created_at FROM daily_tasks WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_tasks (id, title, description, due_date, priority, repeat_type, reminder, tag, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{dueDate}, #{priority}, #{repeat}, #{reminder}, #{tag}, #{createdAt})
